cases.sentence: Теория о том, что связь эта основана на перенесении совокупности воль на ___, есть гипотеза, не подтверждаемая опытом истории.
cases.explain: «исторические лица» — after the preposition «на», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: The life of the nations is not contained in the lives of a few men, for the connection between those men and the nations has not been found. The theory that this connection is based on the transference of the collective will of a people to certain historical personages is an hypothesis unconfirmed by the experience of history.

cases.sentence: Так отвечает ___ историков, признающих безусловную передачу власти.
cases.explain: «первый разряд» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: “The herd goes in that direction because the animal in front leads it and the collective will of all the other animals is vested in that leader.” This is what historians of the first class say—those who assume the unconditional transference of the people’s will.

cases.sentence: Так говорят историки ___, признающие выражениями своего времени все исторические лица, от монархов до журналистов.
cases.explain: «третьего разряда» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: “If the animals in front are continually changing and the direction of the whole herd is constantly altered, this is because in order to follow a given direction the animals transfer their will to the animals that have attracted our attention, and to study the movements of the herd we must watch the movements of all the prominent animals moving on all sides of the herd.” So say the third class of historians who regard all historical persons, from monarchs to journalists, as the expression of their age.

cases.sentence: Так говорят историки третьего разряда, признающие выражениями своего времени все ___, от монархов до журналистов.
cases.explain: «исторические лица» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: “If the animals in front are continually changing and the direction of the whole herd is constantly altered, this is because in order to follow a given direction the animals transfer their will to the animals that have attracted our attention, and to study the movements of the herd we must watch the movements of all the prominent animals moving on all sides of the herd.” So say the third class of historians who regard all historical persons, from monarchs to journalists, as the expression of their age.

cases.sentence: Теория перенесения воль масс на ___ есть только перифраза, — только выражение другими словами слов вопроса.
cases.explain: «исторические лица» — after the preposition «на», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: The theory of the transference of the will of the people to historic persons is merely a paraphrase—a restatement of the question in other words.

cases.sentence: Теория перенесения воль масс на исторические лица есть только перифраза, — только выражение ___ слов вопроса.
cases.explain: «другими словами» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: The theory of the transference of the will of the people to historic persons is merely a paraphrase—a restatement of the question in other words.

cases.explain: «исторических событий» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: What causes historical events? Power. What is power? Power is the collective will of the people transferred to one person. Under what condition is the will of the people delegated to one person? On condition that that person expresses the will of the whole people. That is, power is power: in other words, power is a word the meaning of which we do not understand.

cases.sentence: Не говоря о том, что без понятия власти не может обойтись ни одно описание совокупной деятельности людей, существование власти доказывается как историею, так и наблюдением ___.
cases.explain: «современных событий» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Not to speak of the fact that no description of the collective activity of men can do without the conception of power, the existence of power is proved both by history and by observing contemporary events.

cases.sentence: Историки, по ___ признания божественного участия в делах человечества, хотят видеть причину события в выражении воли лица̀, облеченного властью; но заключение это не подтверждается ни рассуждением, ни опытом.
cases.explain: «старой привычке» — after the preposition «по», the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: The historians, in accord with the old habit of acknowledging divine intervention in human affairs, want to see the cause of events in the expression of the will of someone endowed with power, but that supposition is not confirmed either by reason or by experience.

cases.sentence: Историки, по старой привычке признания ___ в делах человечества, хотят видеть причину события в выражении воли лица̀, облеченного властью; но заключение это не подтверждается ни рассуждением, ни опытом.
cases.explain: «божественного участия» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: The historians, in accord with the old habit of acknowledging divine intervention in human affairs, want to see the cause of events in the expression of the will of someone endowed with power, but that supposition is not confirmed either by reason or by experience.

cases.sentence: Не допуская ___ в делах человечества, мы не можем принимать власть за причину событий.
cases.explain: «божественного участия» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Without admitting divine intervention in the affairs of humanity we cannot regard “power” as the cause of events.

cases.sentence: Власть, с точки зрения опыта, есть только зависимость, существующая между выражением воли лица и исполнением этой воли ___.
cases.explain: «другими людьми» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: Power, from the standpoint of experience, is merely the relation that exists between the expression of someone’s will and the execution of that will by others.
